CANCER (June 21-July 22): Be accommodating, but don’t let anyone take advantage of you. Know what you are willing to do, and set boundaries with those who ask for too much. Choose to contribute your unique perspective on situations that need your attention, and follow through with hands-on help to ensure things unfold in the best way possible. Romance and socializing are highlighted. 3 stars

LEO (July 23-Aug. 22): Tidy up loose ends. Learn as you go, and choose unique alternatives and options that you can adjust to your liking. A change to how you feel will alter your perspective regarding those you help or share life lessons with. Be a good listener, and you’ll discover how best to serve the ones you care about. Love unconditionally. 3 stars [...] Happy Birthday: Stay grounded, listen attentively and look for solutions this year. Change requires researching, discovering your options and finding the best solutions. Question everything and everyone, and refuse to let debt consume you. Stress is the enemy, and finding out where your happiness lies will be your saving grace. Don’t underestimate the power of persuasion or agree to something that can cost you emotionally, financially or physically. Choose peace of mind over temptation. Your numbers are 2, 10, 18, 26, 31, 35, 49. [...] CAPRICORN (Dec. 22-Jan. 19): Take the high road when dealing with difficult individuals. Limit your words to what’s necessary, considerate and helpful. Maintain your reputation using congeniality and kind gestures. Walk away from those trying to twist your words or feed you bad information. A physical or personal change you make will be emotionally gratifying. Live, love, laugh and be happy. 3 stars

AQUARIUS (Jan. 20-Feb. 18): Think twice before you say something you’ll regret. Put your energy into what you can do to improve your life. Living in the past will stifle your ability to reach your personal, financial and emotional goals. Turn your attention to new beginnings and relationships. An opportunity to partner with someone or share expenses is in your best interest. 3 stars
